description.value: Best Falafel is a family-owned Syrian-Lebanese fast food restaurant founded by Damascus-born Hisham Wattar, who has grown the business to three Metro Vancouver locations over more than two decades. The North Vancouver outpost on Lonsdale Avenue is the newest, described as a grand opening location. Cyclists stopping here will find a broad menu of wraps, plates, and salads built on fresh Middle Eastern ingredients, with vegetarian and gluten-free choices available.
